name: dark-sky
title: Dark-sky observation profile
description: Nighttime media documenting artificial light at night (ALAN) and sky quality. SQM, Bortle, and satellite radiance belong in measurements or context joins.
notes: Record SQM in mag/arcsec2 with measurementType=sqm.
Bortle class uses measurementScheme=bortle and measurementValue 1–9.
Calibrated RAW files should be listed as mediaRole=raw with calibrationTarget when a meter or card is used.
